## Feature Proposal
A clear and concise description of what the feature is and what operational capability it introduces.

## Problem / Operational Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or tactical limitation? Ex. *"I need to ingest real-time serial NMEA feeds from a USB GPS dongle..."*

## Proposed Architecture / Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented, including components, data structures, or external libraries if applicable.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, wireframes, mockups, or relevant RFC standards here.
